# Pull Request

> JSPath is a proprietary project. Please open a pull request only after prior discussion or approval from the repository owner.

## Summary

Describe the change clearly and concisely.

## Why is this change needed?

Explain the problem being solved or the improvement being made.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Educational content correction
- [ ] UI / UX improvement
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Test improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Affected areas

List the routes, features, services, or content types affected.

## Testing performed

Confirm the relevant checks:

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run content:audit`
- [ ] `npm run content:verify`
- [ ] `npm run content:examples`
- [ ] `npm run build`

Add any manual testing details below:

```text
Routes tested:
Browsers tested:
Manual scenarios:
```

## Screenshots

For visual changes, include before/after screenshots where useful.

## Content integrity

If this changes educational content:

- [ ] IDs and slugs remain unique
- [ ] References are valid
- [ ] Runnable examples match documented output
- [ ] Exercises/challenges include valid tests
- [ ] Quiz answers include explanations
- [ ] No placeholder or filler content was introduced

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, API keys, credentials, tokens, or private user data are included
- [ ] The change does not weaken sandbox isolation or execution protections

## Scope

- [ ] The pull request is focused on one coherent change
- [ ] Unrelated refactors were avoided
- [ ] Existing architecture and sources of truth were preserved where possible

## Proprietary license acknowledgment

- [ ] I have read the repository's `LICENSE` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] I understand that submitting this pull request does not grant me permission to reuse, republish, distribute, commercialize, or create derivative works from JSPath outside this repository
